resources.string: A fresh release (v6.3.1.62) has been published on the Play Store! Update now to enjoy smoother performance, newly added features, and improved stability. We’ve worked hard to resolve previous issues in this version. For feedback or assistance, feel free to write us at support@mobirec.in. We truly appreciate your support!
